e2e.auth_notes: The arrange actor is the seeded student 小明 (course 1 enrolled at progress 0, period 20) who completes the course in-flow; the grading actor is the seeded teacher 李老师 (owner of course 1). Credentials come from the sample .env only.

db.notes: Arrange: 小明 completes course 1 (progress 0 -> 20, has_exam 0 -> 1 via the exam) because no seeded enrollment combines has_exam=1 with mark=null. Act: teacher 李老师 saves mark 85, updating student_course (1,24) mark null -> 85. The frozen delta therefore contains the arrange's progress/has_exam update plus the mark update. expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). The schema has no volatile columns (no timestamps/counters): every seeded date is fixed in the dump and the flows fill any date input explicitly, so ignore_columns is empty. All six tables are listed so the capture tooling can warn about any change outside the spec. Shiro sessions live in memory, not in the DB — there is no session table to exclude.
